subject: Clarification: SOC 2 coverage boundaries, snapshot evidence, and bridging options
messages:
From: Jenna Park <security@acme.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 09:52:00 -0700
Subject: SOC2 report: coverage dates and evidence snapshot question

Hi Monica / Neha,

Thanks for sending over the SOC 2 Type II package. A few quick clarifications from Acme's compliance team so our intake is complete:

1) The report lists a coverage range of "June 1, 2025 - Aug 31, 2026". For our records we need to confirm whether that range is inclusive of the full days/months — i.e., are controls evaluated for the entire 31 Aug (end-of-day) or is Aug 31 a point-in-time cutoff?

2) For configuration and hardening evidence we typically require a point-in-time snapshot (config/export) tied to the report cutoff. Can you confirm the exact snapshot date and timezone (end-of-day UTC vs local) that you can provide?

3) Our audit calendar has a procurement window Sep 1–15, 2026 where we need continuous coverage. If there is any perceived gap between the report cutoff and our intake, will Redwood provide a bridge letter (auditor-signed) or should we expect a company attestation only?

Attachments: I see a PDF labelled "redwood-soc2-2025-2026-typeii.pdf" in your portal; please confirm it's the official issued report. Also, if you can provide the snapshot CSV for config and a statement of evidence sources that would speed our review.

Can we schedule a 20-minute sync to close these items? I am available Wed 9/8 10–11am PT.

Thanks,
Jenna Park
Sr. InfoSec Manager — Acme Corp
Acme Security Team

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>

Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 8 Sep 2026 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC2 report: coverage dates and evidence snapshot question

Hi Jenna — thanks for the clear list. Quick answers up front, then next steps below.

1) Coverage range: The dates on our report should be interpreted as inclusive of the date range (we list the period covered by the auditor). In practice that means controls testing and evidence collection include activities up to and including Aug 31, 2026. Where evidence is point-in-time we treat the audit cutoff as end-of-day UTC on the final date, unless otherwise noted by the auditor.

2) Snapshot evidence: We can provide a system configuration export taken on 2026-08-31 at 23:59:59 UTC. The snapshot filename is "snapshot-config-2026-08-31.csv" and it contains the inventory and key config hashes used during testing. For operational/continuous controls we will also produce logs extracts (retention windows noted in the report).

3) Bridge letter: Redwood can facilitate a bridge letter. We typically request the auditor draft/issue the bridge as it carries more weight; however, if Acme accepts a company attestation followed by a signed auditor statement, we can accommodate that workflow. I have looped in Neha (compliance) to confirm the auditor engagement status and next steps for an auditor-signed bridge.

Proposed next steps:
- Neha to confirm whether our auditor (BrightAudit LLP) will issue a formal bridge letter and ETA.
- I will upload the CSV snapshot and the engagement letter reference to the Drive link we shared.
- If useful, schedule the 20-minute sync Wed 9/8 10:30am PT (I accepted your window).

I'll follow up shortly with the snapshot and engagement doc.

Best,
Monica Patel
Enterprise Customer Success — Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Jenna Park <security@acme.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 8 Sep 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC2 report: coverage dates and evidence snapshot question

Hi Jenna — quick technical addendum from Redwood compliance:

• Snapshot specifics: the CSV (snapshot-config-2026-08-31.csv) includes host identifiers, package versions, firewall ruleset checksums, and a hash of the applied baseline. We took the snapshot at 2026-08-31T23:59:59Z (UTC). That timestamp matches the evidence hash referenced in the auditor's workpapers.

• Point-in-time vs continuous: For configuration baselines we provide point-in-time exports at cutoff. For controls that are continuous (access logs, change control tickets) we provide rolling extracts that cover the full encompassed period. If you need the rolling window formatted differently (e.g., local time zoning), let us know and we can re-export.

• Bridge letter options: BrightAudit LLP has historically issued auditor-signed bridge letters when requested by customers. I have an open contact there and will confirm whether they will issue a letter covering Sep 1–15, 2026 if we submit the engagement request by EOD Thu 9/9. If BrightAudit declines, Redwood will provide a company attestation that we can have countersigned by our CFO — please confirm which level Acme requires.

• Evidence delivery: I have uploaded the snapshot and engagement letter reference to the Drive link Monica included. If you prefer delivery via a secure SFTP or the compliance portal, we can place the files there and provide one-time access tokens.

Requested from Acme: please confirm whether a company-signed attestation is acceptable as a stop-gap, or whether you require an auditor-signed bridge. Once we have that, I'll coordinate with BrightAudit and share an expected issuance date.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Manager, Compliance — Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com

(attachment: snapshot-config-2026-08-31.csv)

From: Jenna Park <security@acme.com>

Monica / Neha — thanks for the quick turnaround and the detail. A few confirmations from our side: 

• The auditor-signed bridge letter is preferred for procurement review. If BrightAudit can issue it, that will be ideal. If timeline constraints prevent that, we will accept a company attestation only for initial intake but will require the auditor's letter before final acceptance.

• The snapshot timestamp in UTC is perfect — please keep the CSV in the Drive link and also upload to our compliance portal (compliance@acme.com SFTP) if you can.

• For the call tomorrow 9/8 10:30am PT (per original thread) I have accepted the invite. Agenda: confirm bridge issuance ETA, confirm file delivery method, and confirm whether any additional logs extracts are required for procurement.

Appreciate the help — looking forward to closing this quickly.

Best,
Jenna Park
